title: The Machine of New Lagos
author: Dominic Hartwell
blurb: Edmund Ravensworth, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
